result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: CGL at USD 1M per occurrence/2M aggregate, E&O at USD 2M, conditional cyber/privacy coverage at USD 5M, statutory workers’ compensation, and certificates on request. It preserves the existing provisions and is professionally drafted. However, requiring CGL, E&O, and cyber coverage for one year after termination, and triggering cyber coverage based on mere access to data, go beyond the stated playbook and are not necessary to achieve it.
